docs.title: About Me
docs.text: Hello! I'm a passionate Cloud Engineer with a strong background in designing, deploying, and managing scalable cloud solutions. My expertise spans across leading cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.

docs.title: What I Do
docs.text:
• Architect and implement secure, reliable cloud infrastructures
  • Automate deployments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and CloudFormation
  • Optimize cloud resources for performance and cost-efficiency
  • Ensure high availability and disaster recovery for critical applications
  • Collaborate with development teams to enable DevOps practices

Let's connect and build something great in the cloud!

docs.title: How to Build a Secure AWS VPC
docs.text: Learn how to design and deploy a secure Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) on AWS, including subnets, route tables, security groups, and best practices for isolation and access control.

docs.title: Key Steps
docs.text:
• Plan your IP address range (CIDR blocks)
  • Create public and private subnets
  • Set up route tables and internet gateways
  • Configure security groups and NACLs
  • Enable VPC flow logs for monitoring

A well-designed VPC is the foundation of secure cloud infrastructure.

docs.title: CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions
docs.text: Automate your deployments and testing with GitHub Actions. This guide covers setting up workflows for building, testing, and deploying your cloud projects.

docs.title: Key Steps
docs.text:
• Define workflow YAML files in .github/workflows/
  • Use actions for build, test, and deploy
  • Store secrets securely in GitHub
  • Monitor workflow runs and troubleshoot failures

CI/CD is essential for modern, reliable cloud engineering.

docs.title: Terraform Best Practices
docs.text: Discover tips and strategies for writing maintainable, scalable, and secure Terraform code for cloud infrastructure.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
• Use modules for reusable code
  • Keep state files secure (use remote backends)
  • Follow naming conventions
  • Document your resources
  • Test changes in isolated environments

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) enables repeatable, auditable, and efficient cloud deployments.
